pairs.prompt_text:
In D:/code/ESI.ts, I need two things:

1. List all files in `examples/` directory and give me a brief summary of what each one demonstrates (read the first ~30 lines of each).

2. Read the full source of these new client files and their types to understand what methods/endpoints are available:
   - src/clients/SkyhooksClient.ts
   - src/clients/MercenaryClient.ts  
   - src/clients/AccessListsClient.ts
   - src/clients/SovereigntyClient.ts (focus on the new getSovereigntySystems method)
   - src/types/skyhooks.ts
   - src/types/mercenary.ts
   - src/types/access-lists.ts
   - src/types/sovereignty.ts (the SovereigntySystem interface)

3. Read one representative example file fully (e.g., examples/sovereignty.ts or examples/alliance-info.ts) to understand the pattern used — imports, client instantiation, error handling, output formatting.

4. Check package.json for any example-related npm scripts to see the naming convention.

Report back all findings in detail — I need the exact method signatures, type shapes, and example patterns.
